subject: general
question: A cylindrical tank of diameter 14 m contains water up to the depth of 6 m. What is the total area of wetted surface? (Use*pi = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the cylindrical tank = 14 m

Radius of the tank = Diameter ÷ 2 = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 m

Depth of water = 6 m

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Area of curved surface of cylinder = 2 × π × radius × height

Area of circular base = π × radius²

Total wetted surface area = Area of curved surface + Area of circular base
